notes: One predetermined dataset per size, three inference/timing repetitions; not a population-level confirmatory study.
Primary lambda(d)=log(d-1); lambda=1 sensitivity. Native scores for d=12/56; rank-native for d=196. No package-default change.
At a fixed rank count both methods have identical active core allocations; MCMC uses one independent chain per rank.
Each dataset/seed bundle runs on one exclusively allocated node; report active and reserved core-hours separately.

Ranks and methods run in predeclared randomized order. The 128-particle runs are separately labelled fixed-work scaling probes: 32 equally spaced temperatures, 10 moves at every stage regardless of resampling. They are excluded from the primary adaptive quality comparison.
Only complete beta=1 posterior estimates are evaluated. Intermediate tempered SMC targets are not posterior convergence checkpoints.
Large-network references are approximate and must pass independent-group, half-chain and monitored rank-normalized R-hat checks before quality-based ratios are reported.
A one-hour step limit is recorded as a failed/censored attempt, never converted to a successful runtime or speedup. No recovery-based reruns.
This benchmarks the validated implementations, not all possible MCMC/SMC algorithms. Old-prior posteriors are never reused under the new prior.
